business_problem: KP Group needed to scale monitoring, reporting and compliance management across a rapidly growing portfolio of solar and hybrid energy sites without relying on manual plant-by-plant checks and fragmented reporting.
solution_summary: KP Group partnered with IBM to standardize renewable operations on IBM Maximo Renewables. Before the change, engineers had to log into each plant’s SCADA environment separately, juggle dozens of browser tabs and compile reports manually, making it difficult to scale operational oversight as the portfolio expanded. The new platform integrates site telemetry and performance data into Maximo Renewables, while linking the Maximo data warehouse to a self-hosted Microsoft Power BI environment for automated hourly updates to operational and investor dashboards. KP Group uses the platform to manage work orders, monitor generation guarantees, track exceptions and report on performance across more than 70 sites. The result is a centralized operational system that supports predictive maintenance, compliance transparency and faster decisions.

solution_components.name: IBM Maximo Renewables
solution_components.role: Centralizes monitoring, analytics, work management and compliance tracking for KP Group’s renewable assets.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Power BI
solution_components.role: Consumes Maximo warehouse data to deliver automated operational and investor dashboards.

data_flow: Telemetry and operating data from solar and hybrid plants flow from site systems into IBM Maximo Renewables, where work orders, guarantees and performance are managed, and then into Microsoft Power BI dashboards that refresh hourly for operators and investors.
business_outcome: KP Group improved visibility across its portfolio, automated reporting for stakeholders and strengthened compliance and maintenance performance as it scaled toward multi-gigawatt operations.
metrics: 2%–5% reduction in corrective maintenance losses over the next year
architecture_clues: Portfolio spans more than 70 renewable sites
Operational and investor dashboards refresh hourly
Platform tracks generation guarantees and non-controllable event exclusions
evidence_quotes: Engineers had to access each plant’s supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) system individually through static IPs—often keeping dozens of browser tabs open at once.
The solution seamlessly integrated KP Group’s self-hosted Microsoft Power BI platform with the Maximo data warehouse, eliminating manual reporting and facilitating automated hourly updates.
The solution enables the company to meet their contractual obligation to deliver at least 85% of the estimated generation and achieve 100% compliance.
